summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing an ordinary share buyback. On 29 June 2026, it purchased 5,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 109.1711 pence per share. The purchases are part of a buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026 and shares will be cancelled. This is an ongoing capital return programme, not a tender offer or going-private transaction. The filing is a routine update on share repurchases under existing authority. Watch for continued execution pace and potential impact on capital ratios.
